papers.title: WCog-VLA: A Dual-Level World-Cognitive Vision-Language-Action Model for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
papers.summary: 双层次世界认知VLA框架，桥接语义级世界预测与生成式世界演化。Game-CoT推理+ADDT生成世界模型，NAVSIM PDMS 92.9 SOTA

papers.title: Post-Training in End-to-End Autonomous Driving: A Survey
papers.authors: Ruining Yang, Muxing Wang, Yixiao Chen et al.
papers.summary: 首个E2E AD后训练范式综述，将方法分为RL、adversarial、self-supervised、human-feedback四类，分析各范式能力与局限

papers.title: DRIFT: Drift and Aggregation for Motion Planning
papers.summary: 固定深度trajectory planner，一步漂移生成48 proposals +场景感知聚合头。NAVSIM PDMS 89.6，推理仅10.82ms

papers.title: WorkDrive: Roadwork Chain of Causation for Autonomous Driving
papers.summary: 施工路段因果推理框架，Chain-of-Causation + GRPO推理增强。ROADWork ADE降9%，一致性RL再降3%

papers.title: RoboTTT: Test-Time Training Across Task and Motion
papers.summary: 机器人测试时训练方法，在任务和运动层面同步适应，8K timesteps上下文扩展。对AD跨场景泛化有借鉴意义

papers.title: DriftWorld: Fast World Modeling through Drifting
papers.summary: Action-conditioned world model，一步生成未来帧而非迭代去噪，快速机器人规划世界模型

papers.title: CosFly-VLA: A Spatially Aware VLA Model for UAV Tracking
papers.summary: 空间感知VLA策略用于遮挡下UAV跟踪，保持目标状态跨建筑和植被区域

papers.title: Variational Inference for Bird's Eye View Segmentation
papers.summary: 将BEV分割重新表述为变分推理问题，优化多相机融合

papers.title: MIND-CAVs: Multi-Intelligence Negotiation and Decision for CAVs
papers.summary: 意图驱动的网联自动驾驶车辆协商框架，通过边缘计算共享高层次驾驶意图

papers.title: BadWAM: When World-Action Models Dream Right but Act Wrong
papers.summary: World-action模型的对抗性脆弱性分析，揭示动作预测与世界预测耦合的脆弱性
